segments.he:
וֹרֵא [הַבּוֹרֵא] וַאֲמָרָם  בְּאֵימָה  וְיִרְאָה,
וְהָיוּ הַדִּבּוּרִים מְרַתְּתִין כְּשֶׁיָּצָא מִפִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ:
segments.en: (156.) Once he said to me in these words: [in Yiddish: "dos vastu nit az der Barditshover Rav zogt der Boyre shpritsyt ihm fayer fun diy oygn"] — "Do you not know that when the Rabbi of Berdichev says 'the Creator' — fire spurts from the eyes?" And he stressed the words "der Boyre" ["the Creator"] — and said them with awe and reverence. And the words were trembling as they came from his holy mouth.
